mentions.name: Bedevere Wise
mentions.description: A browser-based SQL data viewer for file formats widely used in biostatistics and clinical data: SAS (sas7bdat, xpt), SPSS (sav), Stata (dta), plus Parquet, Excel, and CSV. Users drop a file and immediately run 'SELECT *' and other exploratory queries via DuckDB-WASM, with a custom DuckDB extension the author built supplying statistics and plotting. Everything runs locally in the browser with no installers or configuration, so files never leave the device — important for clinical data. Includes GGSQL, a grammar-of-graphics plotting layer executed inside SQL.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a 'drop file → SELECT * FROM it' workflow for exploratory queries on datasets in biostat/clinical formats — sometimes whole nested subtrees with dozens of mixed-format files — that is easy for colleagues to use (no installers, no configuration) and keeps files on the device for clinical-data privacy.
mentions.audience: Biostatistics and clinical-data people who work with SAS, SPSS, and Stata files, including the author's colleagues
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on Bedevere Wise (https://bedeverewise.app), a browser-based SQL data viewer for the file formats still widely used by biostat / clinical-data people: SAS (sas7bdat, xpt), SPSS (sav), Stata (dta), plus Parquet, Excel, and CSV.
